name: bugbaas

scripts.apk:release: npm run validate:bug-art && cd android && gradlew.bat :app:assembleRelease --console=plain
scripts.apk:fast: npm run validate:bug-art && cd android && gradlew.bat :app:assembleRelease --console=plain -Pandroid.enableMinifyInReleaseBuilds=false -Pandroid.enableShrinkResourcesInReleaseBuilds=false -Pandroid.enablePngCrunchInReleaseBuilds=false
scripts.test:real-bug-scan: node --experimental-strip-types --test src/services/pendingBugDexDiscovery.test.ts src/services/realBugCameraAsset.test.ts src/services/realBugScanContract.test.ts src/services/realBugScanFingerprint.test.ts src/services/realBugScanImagePolicy.test.ts src/services/realBugScanProgress.test.ts src/services/realBugScanReward.test.ts src/services/realBugScanUsage.test.ts && node --test server/realBugScan/*.test.mjs

description: Android-first Expo/React Native app voor interne bugmeldingen, statusopvolging, punten, ranglijst en BugDex.
